Exact block I/O range guards are acquired before submission and retained through completion/drop; busy overlay pages are skipped with safe no-op ACK.
File-engine replacement drains all old kernel operations before old request guards can drop; no dedicated new hot-file-replacement stress claim.
Invalid requests receive no ACK. A possible MAP_FIXED-created mapping hole causes process abort, not resume.
Dirty bitmap is marked after replacement; anonymous overlays retain state-only snapshot rejection.
Reporting-only config is checked at construction, restore final state, runtime use and DAX restore builder path.
Successful-snapshot marker is emitted after state/RAM save on the same event loop and binds discard sequence; later paused-source ACKs are outside saved state.
Lossless host evidence uses opt-in unrestricted logger; ordinary info rate limiting was unsuitable and was fixed.
Host default logger and guest serial both use stdout. Lossless export additionally requires a dedicated --log-path, now set by the revised harness; stdout/stderr redirection alone is insufficient.
